lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A non-uniform constellation of high-luminance circular clusters is visible posterior to the gill slits, featuring a prominent triangular arrangement of three primary spots in the mid-lateral field.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like anchor node pattern across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct linear features run horizontally along the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with highlights on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Four distinct, vertically oriented, parallel linear lacerations are visible traversing the gill slits and extending onto the lower lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Intricate, vermiculated (labyrinth-like) patterning of light-intensity pixel clusters is present on the dorsal and lateral surfaces of the cranial region.
